title: User
description: Represents an Azure AD user account. Inherits from directoryObject. Contains identity, profile, organizational, and authentication properties.

accountEnabled.description: True if the account is enabled; otherwise, false.

assignedLicenses.description: The licenses that are assigned to the user.

assignedPlans.description: The plans that are assigned to the user.

businessPhones.description: The telephone numbers for the user.

city.description: The city where the user is located.

companyName.description: The company name associated with the user.

country.description: The country or region where the user is located.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time the user was created.

department.description: The department in which the user works.

displayName.description: The name displayed in the address book for the user. Required on creation.

employeeId.description: The employee identifier assigned to the user by the organization.

employeeType.description: Captures the enterprise worker type. For example, Employee, Contractor, Consultant, or Vendor.

givenName.description: The given name (first name) of the user.

mail.description: The SMTP address for the user.

mailNickname.description: The mail alias for the user. Required on creation.

mobilePhone.description: The primary cellular telephone number for the user.

officeLocation.description: The office location in the user's place of business.

onPremisesDistinguishedName.description: The on-premises Active Directory distinguished name.

onPremisesImmutableId.description: Used to associate an on-premises Active Directory user account to the Azure AD user object.

onPremisesLastSyncDateTime.description: The last time at which the object was synced with the on-premises directory.

onPremisesSyncEnabled.description: True if this user object is currently being synced from an on-premises Active Directory.

otherMails.description: Additional email addresses for the user.

passwordPolicies.description: Specifies password policies for the user. One of DisableStrongPassword and DisablePasswordExpiration, or both.

postalCode.description: The postal code for the user's postal address.

preferredLanguage.description: The preferred language for the user in ISO 639-1 code format. Example: en-US.

proxyAddresses.description: The proxy addresses for the user. Example: SMTP:user@contoso.com, smtp:alias@contoso.com.

signInSessionsValidFromDateTime.description: Any refresh tokens or session tokens issued before this time are invalid.

state.description: The state or province in the user's address.

streetAddress.description: The street address of the user's place of business.

surname.description: The user's surname (family name or last name).

usageLocation.description: A two-letter country code (ISO 3166). Required for users who will be assigned licenses.

userPrincipalName.description: The user principal name (UPN) of the user. Required on creation. Format: alias@domain.

userType.description: A string value that classifies the user. Typically Member or Guest.
